BiblicalUsage: Ikkesh was the father of Ira, one of David's mighty men, and the Bible names him by his son. In 1 Chronicles 11:28 Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite stands among the mighty men, in 2 Samuel 23:26 the same Ira is listed again, and in 1 Chronicles 27:9 Ira the son of Ikkesh commands the sixth course for the sixth month.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Ikkesh is remembered the way fathers often are: by the son who served the king, and by the course that bore his son's name.
RelatedPeople: Ikkesh; Ira, Son of Ikkesh; King David
